purpose: Pre-Phase-4D source and evidence baseline. Captured from the live worktree before Phase 4D production changes.

repository.head: 205c4fa8d2aae8d5abe5b7806f1fb66bb0727519
notes: The Phase 4C housing source, test, and documentation changes are uncommitted and are treated as part of this live baseline; they were not reverted or staged.

The deleted scene/recovery files and untracked replacement scene/meta pair are recorded as unresolved worktree state. This baseline does not classify them as safe to delete, restore, or keep; inspect provenance and references before acting.
This baseline file and progress.md are intentionally not included in the pre-creation status snapshot above.

phase4cSourceManifest.verificationRule: Resolve each files[].path against projectRoot; recompute SHA-256 and require equality with files[].sha256. The complete 27 path/hash pairs are in the referenced manifest whose own SHA-256 is pinned above.

protectedBoundary.auditLabel: Commander Phase 4C read-only boundary audit (in-flight source; not final phase evidence)
protectedBoundary.verificationRule: Resolve each frozenBoundaryHashes[].path against projectRoot; require present=true, unchanged=true, auditGap=false, baselineSha256=currentSha256, and recomputed disk SHA-256=currentSha256. The exact 55 path/hash records and all changed/new records are in the referenced audit, whose SHA-256 is pinned above.
protectedBoundary.labelCaveat: The JSON label says in-flight/not final, while its 55/55 frozen hashes and all declared changed/new hashes were independently recomputed against the captured worktree and match. Preserve this caveat; do not silently relabel the artifact.

regressionEvidence.dynamicHousingEvidence: The recorded PlayMode scenario starts at population/cap 10/10 without a House, approves Ranged Reinforcement, observes House foundation and completion, then Archer training and ten Archers, plan completion, and reservation release. XML proves the case ran and passed; the summary supplies the scenario detail.

phase4dReadiness.baselineAmbiguity: The live worktree is dirty, but its Phase 4C source manifest and protected boundary hashes verify. Treat these exact live files as the Phase 4D starting point; do not assume the commits alone contain them.
phase4dReadiness.gate: Proceed only after the Phase 4D owner reviews this snapshot and resolves any required direction on the uncommitted scene/recovery churn and the audit-label caveat.
